steps: Inspected existing RoundLoop + EnemyTemplate to make a distinct concept
Authored ServerScriptService.SiegeDirector: a credit-budget wave director (not fixed counts)
Embedded config (archetypes w/ cost, sieges w/ threat budget) self-contained in the script
Reused ServerStorage.EnemyTemplate (with NpcAI) for real player-fought combat
Added [Siege]-tagged lifecycle prints: online, siege start, each spawn, siege cleared, VICTORY
Disabled the pre-existing RoundLoop so this director's progression is observable

recipe.text: SiegeDirector is a credit-budget wave director in the RoundLoop family, distinct from the linear count-based RoundLoop. Each siege has a threat BUDGET the director spends drawing weighted archetypes (Grunt/Runner/Ogre by cost) from a pool, spawning them one-per-interval around a spawn ring. Siege-cleared is detected via Humanoid.Died/AncestryChanged on every spawned enemy; after 3 escalating sieges it prints VICTORY. No auto-kill/TestAutoKill hook — clears require real combat. Config is embedded, no external module.
